title: orthodon angustifolius
intro: Orthodon angustifolius, commonly known as Wild Chamomile, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in Orthodon angustifolius include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, pain relief, and wound healing. Traditional uses of Wild Chamomile include topical applications for skin irritations and internal consumption as a calming tea to promote relaxation and reduce stress.
